name: is_spell_immune_combatant
purpose: Returns 1 when the combat-roster entry's +3 byte (g_roster_member: party index for members, type for monsters) is 0x2f, 0x0e or 0x0f, i.e. the combatant is immune to the sleep/charm/fear/shrink spells and the sleep/kill winds; otherwise 0. Called before target_evades by An Xen Corp, An Xen Ex, Rel Xen Bet, In Quas Corp and the wind spells.
notes: Which monster types 0x0e/0x0f/0x2f are is not verified (Lord British / Shadowlords?).

name: cast_missile_spell
purpose: Combat missile spells Grav Por (0x30), Vas Flam (0x31), Xen Corp (0x32): sets g_attack_weapon = weapon and calls COMSUBS attack_with(weapon, g_active_combatant) which aims the crosshair, animates the missile and applies the damage.

0x589d.name: g_attack_weapon
0x589d.meaning: weapon/spell id of the current attack

0x589e.name: g_active_combatant
0x589e.meaning: roster index whose turn it is

name: cast_field_spell
purpose: Field spells In Flam Grav (0), In Nox Grav (1), In Zu Grav (2), In Sanct Grav (3). Outside combat (only dungeons allow them): CAST2 e1e0 casting flash of circle 4 (kind 3) or 3; the dungeon cell ahead of the party (x/y + facing delta words at 0x24d6/0x24de, masked & 7, level g_party_z) must satisfy (cell & 0xf7) == 0 (else returns 0) and becomes (cell & 8) | g_field_dungeon_cell[kind] (0x4596: 0x82 0x81 0x80 0x83). In combat the field is thrown as weapon g_field_weapon[kind] (0x4592: 0x35 0x33 0x34 0x36) via g_attack_weapon and COMSUBS attack_with. Returns 0xffff (no message).

0x4592.name: g_field_weapon
0x4592.meaning: combat weapon ids of the four field spells

0x4596.name: g_field_dungeon_cell
0x4596.meaning: dungeon cell codes of the four field spells

name: cast_an_zu_awaken
purpose: An Zu. CAST2 e27e picks the member (negative = cancel -> 0xffff). A sleeping member ('S') becomes 'G'; in combat the roster entry with (flags & 0xe8) == 0x88 and that member index is woken with wake_combatant; casting flash circle 1, g_status_dirty = 1, returns 0xffff (no message). Not asleep -> 0 ('Failed!').

name: cast_an_nox_cure
purpose: An Nox. CAST2 e27e picks the member (negative -> 0xffff). 'P' becomes 'G', casting flash circle 1, g_status_dirty = 1, returns 1 ('Success!'); otherwise 0 ('Failed!').

name: cast_mani_heal
purpose: Mani. CAST2 e27e picks the member (negative -> -1); CAST2 e5a2(member) heals and returns 1/0; when non-zero the circle-1 casting flash is shown. Returns that result (1 Success, 0 Failed, -1 no message).

name: cast_an_ylem_dissolve
purpose: An Ylem. CAST2 e4e6 asks a direction (0 = cancel -> 0xffff); casting flash circle 1; the map tile at (g_dy, g_dx) is replaced by 0x44 when it is 0x9d, 0x5b, 0x90..0x93, 0xa5..0xa6, 0xa8..0xa9 or 0xad..0xaf (rock/wall-like tiles): prints 'POOF!' (0x459a), g_view_dirty |= 2, refresh_map_view, play_tone_sweep(0x28,1,2000,0x4b0), returns 0xffff. Other tiles return 0 ('Failed!').

name: cast_an_sanct_unlock
purpose: An Sanct. Towns/combat: CAST2 e4e6 direction (0 -> 0xffff); a locked door 0xb9/0xbb at (g_dy,g_dx) becomes the tile one less (unlocked), g_view_dirty |= 2, flash circle 2, returns 1; else the monster/object table is scanned for a chest (byte 0 == 1) at (g_dx,g_dy) on the party z (z test skipped in combat): its +5 byte loses bit 7, flash circle 2, returns 1; nothing -> 0. Dungeons: flash circle 2; the party's cell, or the cell ahead when that is not a chest, with (cell & 0xf0) == 0x40: bit 0 -> 'Disarmed!' (0x45a1); cell = (cell & 8) | 0x70; 'Chest opened!' (0x45ac); returns 0xffff; no chest -> 0.

0x5c5a.name: g_monster_table
0x5c5a.meaning: monster/object table: tile, anim tile, x, y, z, flags(+5 bit7 = locked/trapped chest), ...

notes: The z comparison is char == byte in the C, so z 0xff (underworld) never matches; kept faithful with a TODO.

name: cast_an_xen_corp_repel_undead
purpose: An Xen Corp. Casting flash circle 2 (CAST2 e1e0), then for each of the 32 roster entries: not spell-immune, (flags & 0xc0) == 0x40 (monster), type byte +3 has g_monster_flags[type] bit 0x20 (undead) and COMSUBS target_evades(0, i, g_active_combatant) == 0 -> entry byte +0 = 1 and flags |= 2 (the monster flees).

name: cast_in_wis_locate
purpose: In Wis: casting flash circle 2 then CAST2 e8cc (prints the position, shared with the sextant).

name: cast_kal_xen_summon_animal
purpose: Kal Xen in combat. Flash circle 2; type by rand 0..15: <6 0x14, <11 0x16, <14 0x15, else 0x22. Up to 8 tries of COMBAT random_combat_cell + combat_cell_free(g_dy, g_dx, 0x90), else 0. add_combatant(g_party_z, g_dy, g_dx, 0, type) (negative -> 0); the slot's tile and anim tile are 0x16 during tile_transition_effect(g_dy, g_dx, type*4+0x140), then (char)(type*4+0x40); roster flags |= 1 (allied). Returns 1.

0xba16.name: g_roster_flags
0xba16.meaning: roster entry +2 flags: 0x80 party, 0x40 monster, 0x20 out, 0x10 invisible, 0x08 asleep?, 0x02 fleeing, 0x01 allied

name: cast_in_xen_mani_create_food
purpose: In Xen Mani: flash circle 2, g_food += rand 1..3 capped at 9999 via add_i16_capped, g_status_dirty = 1, returns 1.

name: cast_in_por_blink
purpose: In Por. Outside combat: CAST2 e4e6 direction (0 -> -1); flash circle 3; step = (g_dx-g_party_x, g_dy-g_party_y); from (g_dx&0xff, g_dy&0xff) walk while g_chunk_x <= x < min(g_chunk_x+0x20,0x100) and likewise y; each grass tile (5) sets g_party_x/y = (x,y), g_view_dirty = 1, result -1 (so the party ends on the LAST grass cell along the line); if moved, MAINOUT init_overworld. In combat with g_combat_flags bit 1 clear: flash circle 3, up to 7 tries of random_combat_cell + combat_cell_free(g_dy, g_dx, caster's tile); success writes the roster x/y and monster-table x/y of the caster and returns 1; else 0.

0x589b.name: g_chunk_x
0x589b.meaning: x of the loaded 32x32 overworld window

0x58a1.name: g_combat_flags
0x58a1.meaning: bit 1 = teleport/blink forbidden on this map

notes: The Ghidra loop compares x/y as unsigned against g_chunk_x/y and signed against the limits.

name: cast_wis_quas_reveal
purpose: Wis Quas: flash circle 4; every roster entry with flags != 0, bit 7 clear (monster) and bit 4 set (invisible) loses bit 4 and gets its anim tile (monster table +1) restored from its tile (+0); place_objects_in_view + draw_map_view after each.

name: cast_in_bet_xen_insect_swarm
purpose: In Bet Xen: flash circle 5; up to 8 tries of random_combat_cell + combat_cell_free(g_dy, g_dx, 0xbc); if found, up to 4 x add_combatant(g_party_z, g_dy, g_dx, 0, 0x1f) with roster flags |= 1, stopping at the first failure. Returns 1 if any was added else 0.

name: cast_an_ex_por_magic_lock
purpose: An Ex Por: CAST2 e4e6 direction (0 -> 0xffff); flash circle 5; tile at (g_dy,g_dx) 0xb8..0xb9 -> 0x97, 0xba..0xbb -> 0x98 (magically locked doors), g_view_dirty |= 2, returns 1; otherwise 0.

name: cast_vas_mani_great_heal
purpose: Vas Mani. CAST2 e27e picks the member (negative -> 0xffff). Status 'D', or in combat (g_location > 0x7f) while g_no_more_enemies == 0 (the condition is duplicated in the code) -> 0. Otherwise HP (+0x10) = max HP (+0x12), flash circle 5, g_status_dirty = 1, returns 1.

0x58a3.name: g_no_more_enemies
0x58a3.meaning: non-zero once all enemies are gone

name: cast_in_vas_por_ylem_earthquake
purpose: In Vas Por Ylem in combat. Flash circle 6, earthquake_shake; for every occupied roster entry on the enemy side (combatant_side != 0): if COMBAT get_combat_stat(-2, i) <= random_damage_1_30(): flash_monster(i), damage rand 1..20 via COMBAT apply_damage(dmg, i); the returned experience is added to the caster's record +0x14 (cap 9999) and COMSUBS print_hit_result(g_active_combatant, i).
notes: The third argument Ghidra shows for apply_damage is the exp pointer reused by add_i16_capped.

name: cast_an_xen_ex_charm
purpose: An Xen Ex. 'Creature: ' (0x45bb); COMSUBS aim_crosshair(15, g_active_combatant) == 0 -> 0xffff. Flash circle 6. The crosshair tile must not be 0x84/0x85; find_combatant_at(cy,cx) >= 0, not spell-immune, combatant_side != 0 and target_evades(0, t, active) == 0: roster flags ^= 1 (allied toggle); if bit 7 (party member) that member's status = 'G' and draw_status_window; print_combatant_name(t) + ' charmed!' (0x45c6); return 0xffff. Else 0.

name: cast_rel_xen_bet_shrink
purpose: Rel Xen Bet. 'Creature: ' (0x45d1); aim_crosshair(15, active) == 0 -> 0xffff; flash circle 6; combatant at the crosshair exists, not spell-immune, target_evades == 0: COMBAT remove_combatant(-1 - t) then add_combatant(g_party_z, y, x, 0, 0x14) on its cell; returns 1. Else 0.

name: cast_sanct_lor_invisibility
purpose: Sanct Lor: the active combatant's monster-table anim tile (+1) = 0x1d, roster flags |= 0x10 (invisible), flash circle 7, returns 1.

name: cast_in_quas_xen_clone
purpose: In Quas Xen. 'Creature: ' (0x45dc); aim_crosshair(15, active) == 0 -> -1; flash circle 7; no combatant at the crosshair -> 0. First free monster-table slot (tile 0) and first free roster entry (flags 0), 0xff when none (result then uninitialised). The target's 8-byte roster entry and 8-byte monster-table slot are copied into them (new entry's slot byte = new slot); then random_combat_cell + combat_cell_free(g_dy, g_dx, 0x1c) is retried until a free cell is found, which becomes the clone's roster x/y and monster-table x/y; returns 1.
notes: Infinite retry loop until a free cell; uninitialised return when no free slot/entry (translated as 0).

name: cast_in_quas_corp_fear
purpose: In Quas Corp: flash circle 7; every monster entry ((flags & 0xc0) == 0x40) that is not spell-immune and fails target_evades(0, i, active) gets byte +0 = 1 and flags |= 2 (flees).

name: cast_vas_rel_por_gate_travel
purpose: Vas Rel Por. Only when (g_transport_tile & 0xf0) != 0x20 (not on a ship): 'To phase: ' (0x45e7), read_command_key echoed if printable, newline; '1'..'8' -> moonstone n = key-'1', flash circle 8, ROOT moongate_travel(n); success -> 0xffff (the caller then returns 0 = no turn consumed). Otherwise 0 ('Failed!').

name: cast_an_tym_negate_time
purpose: An Tym: flash circle 8; any monster-table slot with tile 0xfc (Shadowlord) -> 'Magic absorbed!' (0x45f2), play_sweep_noise(2,1000,0x6d60,1,0x2648), returns 0. Else g_status_icon = 'T', g_protection_turns = 10, draw_status_window, returns -1 (no message).

0x588e.name: g_protection_turns
0x588e.meaning: turns left of the status effect

name: cast_spell_command
purpose: The Cast command (vector 1778:06da; ROOT dispatch_command 'C', COMBAT a8ce). g_save_unk_2e9 = 1, attack-is-spell flag 0x5890 = 1; caster = select_target_member (negative returned as is); 'Spell name:' (0x4603); spell = CAST2 e2be: -1 'None!' (0x4611), -2 'No effect!' (0x4618). circle = spell/6+1 stored in g_save_unk_2e9. Permission byte g_spell_unk_1c90[spell]: bit 8 overworld, 4 town (loc < 0x21), 2 dungeon, 1 combat; castle LB (0x12) without g_crown_lb or loc 0x1d -> 'Absorbed!' (0x4624) + play_sweep_noise(2,1000,0x6d60,1,0x2648); not permitted -> 'Not here!' (0x462f) + play_tone_sweep(0x32,1,2000,800). g_mixed_spells[spell] == 0 -> 'None mixed!' (0x463a); else decremented. MP (+0xf) < circle -> 'M.P. too low!' (0x4647) and Failed; MP -= circle; level (+0x16) < circle -> Failed. Dispatch by spell index 0..0x2f: 0 In Lor eaca(100)+flash 1; 1 Grav Por missile 0x30; 2 An Zu; 3 An Nox; 4 Mani; 5 An Ylem; 6 An Sanct; 7 An Xen Corp; 8 Rel Hur e5ea(0, e4e6()); 9 In Wis; 10 Kal Xen; 11 In Xen Mani; 12 Vas Lor eaca(255)+flash 3; 13 Vas Flam 0x31; 14-16 fields 0-2; 17 In Por; 18 An Grav e99c(1); 19 In Sanct ead8(4,20,'P'); 20 In Sanct Grav field 3; 21/22 Uus/Des Por: not at loc 0x28, flash 4, DUNGEON dungeon_klimb_ladder(1, -1/+1) then exit_dungeon if it returns non-zero; 23 Wis Quas; 24 In Bet Xen; 25 An Ex Por; 26 In Ex Por e948 (+flash 5 unless -1); 27 Vas Mani; 28 In Zu wind(g_ui_color4, 1); 29 Rel Tym ead8(5,30,'Q'); 30 In Vas Por Ylem(caster); 31 Quas An Wis ead8(6,20,'C'); 32 In An ead8(6,10,'N'); 33 Wis An Ylem flash 6 + e64c; 34 An Xen Ex; 35 Rel Xen Bet; 36 Sanct Lor; 37 Xen Corp 0x32; 38 In Quas Xen; 39 In Quas Wis flash 7 + gem view (LOOKOBJ b38c / DNGLOOK a938); 40 In Nox Hur wind(g_ui_color3, 2); 41 In Quas Corp; 42 In Mani Corp e7c0(0, e27e()) + status; 43 Kal Xen Corp e6a2(0); 44 In Vas Grav Corp wind(g_ui_color2, 4); 45 In Flam Hur wind(g_ui_color0, 3); 46 Vas Rel Por (success -> return 0); 47 An Tym. Result 1 -> 'Success!' (0x4656), 0 -> 'Failed!' (0x4660) + tone. Returns 1 (turn used) or 0.

0x588f.name: g_save_unk_2e9
0x588f.meaning: circle of the spell being cast (1 before selection)

0x1c90.name: g_spell_unk_1c90
0x1c90.meaning: per-spell context bits: 8 overworld, 4 town, 2 dungeon, 1 combat

0x13ae.name: g_ui_color0
0x13ae.meaning: palette colour used by In Flam Hur

0x13b2.name: g_ui_color2
0x13b2.meaning: colour of In Vas Grav Corp

notes: Early exits (None!/No effect!/Absorbed!/Not here!/None mixed!) return the AX left by print_string or the sound routine (undefined); the port returns 1.

name: use_scroll
purpose: g_scrolls[scroll] -= 1, 'Scroll' (0x466a). 0 Vas Lor: eaca(0xf0), 'Light!' (0x4673), flash 0, 1. 1 Rel Hur: 'Wind change!' (0x467b), dir = e4e6; loc < 0x21 -> e5ea(1, dir), 1; else 0. 2 In Sanct: 'Protection!' (0x4689) ead8(2,100,'P'). 3 In An: 'Negate magic!' (0x4696) ead8(3,20,'N'). 4 In Quas Wis: 'View!' (0x46a5); loc < 0x80: flash 4 and LOOKOBJ view_gem_map(y,x) (loc < 0x21) or DNGLOOK view_gem_dungeon; else 'Not here!' (0x46ac). 5 Kal Xen Corp: 'Summon Daemon!' (0x46b7); combat -> return e6a2(1); else 'Not here!' (0x46c7). 6 In Mani Corp: 'Resurrection!' (0x46d2); loc < 0x80 -> e7c0(1, e27e()) + draw_status_window, return it; else 'Not here!' (0x46e1). 7 An Tym: loc 0x1d/0x28 -> 'No effect!' (0x46ec) + tone; else 'Negate time!' (0x46f8) ead8(7,20,'T'). Returns 1 otherwise.

name: use_potion
purpose: g_potions[potion] -= 1, 'Potion' (0x4706). Drinker: e27e outside combat, else g_roster_member[g_active_combatant]; negative -> returned. Flash of circle `potion`. rand 0..15: 0 -> potion = 4 (orange), 1 -> potion = rand 0..7. 0 blue (awaken): 'S' -> 'G' (combat: the active entry must be that member with flags & 0xe8 == 0x88, wake_combatant(active), 1); else 0; outside combat draw_status_window, 1. 1 yellow: e5a2(m) (0 -> 0), 'Healed!' (0x470e). 2 red: 'P' -> 'G' 'Poison cured!' (0x4717) else 0. 3 green: 'G' -> 'P' 'POISONED!' (0x4726) else 0. 4 orange: 'G' -> 'S' (combat: incapacitate_combatant(m)) 'Slept!' (0x4731) else 0. 5 purple: combat 'Poof!' (0x4739), active combatant's tile/anim tile = 0x90, 1. 6 black: combat flags |= 0x10, 'Invisible!' (0x4740), tiles 0x1d, 1. 7 white: loc < 0x21 -> e64c, 1. 5..7 otherwise 'No noticeable effect now!' (0x474c), 1. After messages 1..4 draw_status_window; returns 1.

name: bury_moonstone
purpose: 'Moonstone ' (0x4768); outside dungeons on tile 0x2c, 0x2d or 4..10: 'buried!' (0x4773), g_moonstone_x/y[n] = g_party_x/y, g_moonstone_loc[n] = g_location, g_moonstone_z[n] = g_party_z; else 'cannot be buried here!' (0x477c).

name: use_gem_shard
purpose: Gem shards 0 Falsehood, 1 Hatred, 2 Cowardice. Prints 0x4794 + name (0x47cc/0x47d9/0x47e3); sweep noise rising 2000..25000 step 50 then falling (play_sweep_noise(0, f, 200, 1, 0xa50)). The party must be at g_shard_sites[shard]: x 0x4882, y 0x4886, location 0x488a, z 0x488e (byte compares), else 'No effect!' (0x47f0) + tone. animate_wait(7), 0x47fe + Truth/Love/Courage (0x4822/0x482a/0x4831), 3 x earthquake_shake, animate_wait(3). find_object_at(z, y-1, x) must be 0xfc (Shadowlord) and shard == g_save_unk_325; then TOWN remove_npc(find_npc_by_slot(g_dx)), 7 x flash_tile_at(y-1, x), g_shadowlord_loc[shard] = 0xff, shard flag 0x57b6+shard = 0, byte 0x5bca |= g_shard_doom_bits[shard] (0x4892: 2,4,8), 'The doom of the Shadowlord ' (0x483b) + Faulinei/Astaroth/Nosfentor (0x4858/0x4861/0x486a) + ' is wrought!' (0x4874), play_triple_sweep_sound.

0x4882.name: g_shard_sites
0x4882.meaning: flame positions per shard: x[3], y[3] at +4, location[3] at +8, z[3] at +0xc

0x4892.name: g_shard_doom_bits
0x4892.meaning: bits 2,4,8 or'ed into 0x5bca when a Shadowlord is destroyed

0x58cb.name: g_save_unk_325
0x58cb.meaning: which Shadowlord (0..2) is at the flame

name: remove_status_effect_if
purpose: If icon == g_status_icon: 'Removed!' (0x4895), g_protection_turns = 0, g_status_icon = 0, g_status_dirty = 1. Returns icon != (old) g_status_icon, i.e. true when the item effect should now be applied.

name: use_item_command
purpose: Use item (vector 1778:06c2; dispatch_command 'U', combat Use). ZSTATS snapshot_items_page; first = next_owned(0xff, 0xb9ee, 0x26, -1) (-1 -> 'No usable items!' 0x489f). 'Item: ' (0x48b1); clear_status_separator, window 1, draw_status_title('Items:' 0x48b8), draw_list_frame(8), sel = ready_browser('U', 0xff, first); icon bar/top bar/separator/status window redrawn; sel < 0 returns. 0..7 use_scroll, 8..15 use_potion(sel-8), 0x15..0x1c bury_moonstone(sel-0x15); then by sel-0x10: 0 Carpet (0x48bf): loc < 0x21 and party tile != 0x0c: transport 0x1c -> 'Boarded!' (0x48c8), g_transport_tile = 0x14 + rand 0..1, g_magic_carpets -= 1; ship -> 'X-it ship first!' (0x48d2); else 'Only on foot!' (0x48e4); elsewhere 'Not here!' (0x48f3). 1 Skull Key: g_skull_keys -= 1, (0x48fe); outside dungeons ok = CAST2 e948, and if ok and not combat flash_tile_at(g_dy, g_dx); dungeon 'Not here!' (0x4909). 2 Amulet (0x4914) / 3 Crown (0x4930): remove_status_effect_if(0x0e / 0x1c) false -> done; else 'Wearing the Amulet' (0x491d) / 'Thou dost don the Crown' (0x4938) + ' of Lord British...' (0x4a84), ead8(9, 0xff, icon). 4 Sceptre (0x4950, 0x495a, 0x4a84), play_sweep_noise(1, 5000, 50000, 1, 0x1450); outside 0x21..0x28 the 3x3 around the party: tiles 0x70..0x7f -> 5 with refresh_map_view + play_random_tones(2000,3000,10), counted; none -> e99c(0): 1 'Field dissolved!' (0x496f), 0 'No effect!' (0x4981). 0xd..0xf use_gem_shard(sel-0x1d). 0x10 Spyglass (0x498d): loc < 0x21 and z < 0x80: hour < 6 or > 18 -> 'Looking...' (0x4998) LOOKOBJ look_telescope, else 'No stars!' (0x49a4); else 'Not here!' (0x49af). 0x11 Plans (0x49ba): ship -> g_hms_cape_plans |= 0x80 (0x49c2) else (0x49e1). 0x12 Sextant (0x49fc): z < 0x80 and loc == 0: night -> 'Position:' (0x4a26) e8cc, day 'Only at night!' (0x4a16); else 'Only outdoors!' (0x4a06). 0x13 Watch (0x4a30): hour%12 (0 -> 12) print_number(' ',1), ':', print_number('0',2,minute), ' AM.'/' PM.' (0x4a55/0x4a4f). 0x14 Badge (0x4a5b): remove_status_effect_if(0x1d) true -> 'Badge worn!' (0x4a63), g_status_icon = 0x1d, g_protection_turns = 0xff, g_status_dirty. 0x15 Box 'How?' (0x4a70). ok == 0 -> 'Failed!' (0x4a7b) + tone.
notes: The original's return value is a leftover register (BX); both callers ignore it. The port returns the ok flag.

name: plot_wind_pixel
proto: int plot_wind_pixel(uint color, uint y, int x)
purpose: One wind-particle step (Ghidra param_1=color, param_2=y, param_3=x). Pixel outside 8..0xb6 on either axis: g_dx = g_dy = -1, returns 0 (particle done). Else set_color(color), plot_pixel(y,x) and (y,x+1), start_tone(rand 100..10000). Even y -> returns 1 without touching g_dx/g_dy. Odd y -> pixel_to_view_cell(y,x); if g_dx,g_dy >= 0 returns view_tile_missile_passable(g_dy,g_dx) else 0.

name: animate_wind_cone
proto: int animate_wind_cone(int dir, int roster_index, int color, int *ys, int *xs)
purpose: Animates 21 particles for a wind spell cast by roster entry ri in direction dir (1 W, 2 E, 3 N, 4 S) and records the view cells reached (Ghidra param_1=dir, param_2=ri, param_3=color, param_4=ys, param_5=xs; ys/xs are 64-int arrays on the caller's stack). Start pixel = (x*16+8, y*16+8) moved to the leading edge: W/E y+16, E x+24, N x+16, S x+16/y+24. Energies: 21-word copy of g_unk_1cf0 at 0xa9d0; done[21] = 0. Passes until all 21 done: each live particle takes rand 0..15 steps; a step calls plot_wind_pixel(color+8, y, x) (0 -> done); when it reports passable and g_dx/g_dy in 0..10, g_view_tiles[dy*0x20+dx] == 0 and fewer than 63 recorded: count += 1, xs[count] = g_dx, ys[count] = g_dy (index 0 never written), view byte = 0xff. Then energy -= 10, move 1 px in dir; energy < 1 -> sideways drift (particles 0..9 by -1, 10..20 by +1: W y-=s, E y+=s, N x+=s, S x-=s) and energy += g_unk_1cf0[i]. stop_tone; returns count.

0xa9d0.name: g_wind_energy
0xa9d0.meaning: BSS scratch copy of g_unk_1cf0 for the running wind spell

0xab02.name: g_view_tiles
0xab02.meaning: view tile buffer (used as a visited mask here)

notes: Ghidra's local_ba/local_c0 byte offsets are one combined record index; stack arrays become Rust slices.

name: cast_wind_spell
proto: void cast_wind_spell(uint color, int kind, int roster_index)
purpose: Wind/cone spells (Ghidra param_1=color, param_2=kind, param_3=ri): 1 In Zu sleep, 2 In Nox Hur poison, 3 In Flam Hur flame, 4 In Vas Grav Corp death. dir = CAST2 e4e6; play_random_tones(700, 16000/19200/20800 by kind, 800); n = animate_wind_cone(dir, ri, color, ys, xs). If n >= 1, for i in 0..=n (index 0 is uninitialised stack in the original): scan roster 31..0 for an entry with x == xs[i], y == ys[i], +5 bit 7 clear, flags & 0x20 clear and flags != 0; set +5 bit 7; kind 1: target_evades(0,j,ri) or spell-immune -> stop, else flash_monster + incapacitate_combatant(j); kind 2: random_damage_1_30() < get_combat_stat(-2,j) -> stop, else flash + COMBAT poison_attack(ri,j); kind 3: flash, apply_damage(rand 0..30, j), xp added to the caster's record +0x14 (cap 9999); kind 4: checks as 1, then apply_damage(99, j) + xp; other kinds stop. print_hit_result(ri, j); only the first entry per cell. Finally bit 7 of +5 is cleared in all 32 entries (0xbb11 down to 0xba19).

0xba19.name: g_roster_hit_flag
0xba19.meaning: roster entry +5; bit 7 = already hit by the current wind spell
